name: cache-warm
description: Claude Code only. Keep this session's prompt cache warm while the user steps away, so coming back doesn't pay a full cache rewrite. Use when the user says "cache-warm", "keep the cache warm", "hold the cache", "keepwarm", "I'll be back in N hours", or asks to stop/cancel a running cache hold. Takes an optional duration ("2h", "90m", "until 18:00"); default 2h.

findings.excerpt: for i in $(seq 1 N); do date -d "+$((i*50)) min" '+%M %H %d %m'; done
